note: Amal's listening / checking lists (scripts/build_amal_checks.py). scripts/build_tutor_data.py puts one row per list on her Tutor hub.

lists.title: Listen: what did the student say?
lists.what: 27 short clips of the student. A second AI listen changed how these lines are written - tell us what he really said. About 10 minutes.

lists.title: Listen: the student's own corrections
lists.what: 13 short clips of the student. His line is written in two or three ways - which one did he say? About 5 minutes.

lists.title: Listen: did the student say this word? - part 1 of 2
lists.what: 42 short clips of the student (part 1 of 2). You say a word a few seconds later - did the student say it himself, in his own line? About 13 minutes.

lists.title: Listen: did the student say this word? - part 2 of 2
lists.what: 42 short clips of the student (part 2 of 2). You say a word a few seconds later - did the student say it himself, in his own line? About 13 minutes.

lists.title: Listen: old or new line?
lists.what: 11 short clips of the student. His line is written two ways - which one did he say? About 4 minutes.

lists.title: Check: is this word really there?
lists.what: 28 short clips of the student. He was given credit for a word here - listen and tell us if he really said it. About 8 minutes.

lists.title: Check: one mistake or two?
lists.what: Two mistakes written down from the same moment of a lesson. Is it the same mistake written twice, or two different mistakes? About 12 minutes.

lists.title: Listen: what did the student say? - part 2
lists.what: Short clips of the student. A second AI listen wants to change how these lines are written, but the new words are your own words from the same minute, or sit on a mistake you marked - so the change waits for your ear (TR-27). Tell us what he really said. About 13 minutes.
